stemMarkdown: Find the difference between the compound interest and the simple interest on ₹8000 for 2 years at 8% per annum (interest compounded annually).
solutionMarkdown: SI for 2 years $= \dfrac{P \times r \times t}{100} = \dfrac{8000 \times 8 \times 2}{100} = 1280.00$. CI for 2 years $= P\left[(1+r/100)^2 - 1\right] = 8000\left[(1+8/100)^2 - 1\right] = 1331.20$. Difference $= 1331.20 - 1280.00 = 51.20$.
